title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer

Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Natural Language SQL Agent
bullets: Built a text-to-SQL agent that turns business questions into Spark SQL over lakehouse tables, combining schema retrieval, few-shot prompting and LangChain tool calls for self-correction.
Evaluated generated queries against a curated question set using execution accuracy and LLM judges, tracked runs in MLflow and deployed the agent as a FastAPI service on Azure.

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI Forward Deployed Engineer role in Amsterdam. As a Senior GenAI Engineer I have spent recent years putting RAG and multi-agent applications into production, on top of a longer background in data science with Spark, pandas and scikit-learn. My work keeps returning to one question: how do we get a promising GenAI idea through evaluation and into real use?

Databricks sits where data and AI meet for a huge number of organisations, and helping customers build first-of-their-kind applications on that platform is the work I want to do next. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Amsterdam together and settle there long term.

I would bring production rollouts with measurable results. In my current role I built a multi-agent analytics chatbot in LangGraph that runs PySpark analysis and cut manual analysis by 98%, with evaluation pipelines that reduced human review by 43%. Before that, I delivered POCs and consulting for 15+ clients, explaining models to technical and business audiences alike.

Outside work, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Teaching through that project has made me better at explaining complex ideas simply, which I would bring to your customers. I would welcome a conversation.
